card: Write the P5 scrub families as walk grades, both directions
seat: integration supervising; implementer writes in hauska-factory-p5-scrub; planner commits
missionPremise: P5 is the largest untouched CTX block and it is code. It can only RUN after P4 but can be WRITTEN now. A standalone scrub script would be a fifth dormant mechanism. Families extend src/stages/grade/v-rules.mjs and src/jobs/verify-walk.mjs. A-021 already gates production on a passed walk. Sources: _dispatches/2026-08-31_p5-scrub_dispatch.md; write-path read of v-rules.mjs and conformant.mjs 2026-08-31T14:20Z; OPS-19 F-08.
completionPredicate: meaningShaped derivation answered from enumerated call sites. If caller-declared, that is family zero and is fixed so one party cannot satisfy both evidence.pass and meaningShaped. Fourteen S-families exist as extensions of the grade set / walk, each with a second independently derived input. Every family fails a poison fixture and passes a known-good fixture. Poison fixtures kept. No standalone scrub script. No production scrub, bake, or publish. Diff in the registered worktree. Planner commits.
scopeBasis: hauska-factory this worktree only. Write and test. Do not run a production scrub. Do not open another Factory tree. HTTP families area-sweep, never random.

adversarial.claim: meaningShaped is derived from evidence provenance
adversarial.finding: PRELIMINARY write-path read: gradeRule takes meaningShaped as a caller argument. conformant.mjs ~1072 passes meaningShaped: true as a literal beside evidence.pass: true. That is internal consistency. Implementer must enumerate EVERY call site and confirm or refute. If confirmed, fixing the derivation is the first family, before S1.
adversarial.rejectedAlternative: trust MEANING.has(ruleId) as the second derivation; rejected because that set is a static allowlist in the same module, not an independently derived input

adversarial.claim: a new scripts/p5-scrub.mjs next to verify-walk is fine if tests call it
adversarial.finding: A script that runs in no workflow is dormant. The walk already gates production. Families that are not invoked from verify-walk (or gradeRule used by the walk) do not exist as controls.
adversarial.rejectedAlternative: export S-rules and never call them from the walk; rejected as starved

adversarial.claim: two fields on one served body are two derivations
adversarial.finding: Two fields from one payload from one upstream are one derivation. Each family needs a second independently derived input. If none exists, construct one. Do not weaken the family.
adversarial.rejectedAlternative: compare body.status to body.content; rejected as internal consistency

familyZero.what: Enumerate gradeRule call sites. If meaningShaped is caller-declared, derive it from evidence provenance (two sources) or refuse PASS. A caller literal true is the vacuity every S-family would inherit.
familyZero.executes: gradeRule + call-site change + test that a literal-only pass is UNMEASURED or refused
familyZero.fails: PASS on presence-only or caller-declared meaning
familyZero.bypasses: a job that builds its own grade object and never calls gradeRule

families.S2b: asOf vs bakedAt (evaluation time vs bake time)
families.S3: landUse / yearBuilt / acreage three-way; disagreement refuses
families.S4: ST_Contains point vs own ring vs join label
families.S5: refused roster vs served body names that refusal
families.S6: facets vs get_smart_site vs PE vs MCP (reader vs reader)
families.S10: identifier key vs registry (six key forms)
families.S13: placeholder provenance allowlist; envelope vs rule

wiring.what: S-ids join RULE_IDS or a sibling S_RULE_IDS consumed by verify-walk. Walk invokes them. Tests are node --test. Poison fixtures live next to existing broken-parcel fixtures and stay.
wiring.fails: poison -> FAIL; known-good -> PASS; family with no fail arm is not written
wiring.bypasses: a walk that skips S-rules unless a flag is set (flag-off is starved; default on)

falsifiers.meaningShapedLiteral: If a caller can pass {evidence:{pass:true}, meaningShaped:true} with no second source and get PASS, family zero is not done.
falsifiers.familyOneDirection: A family that only has a passing fixture is not written. Missing fail arm = card failed for that family.
falsifiers.standaloneScript: If the only entry is a script nothing in verify-walk or a workflow calls, the card failed.
falsifiers.poisonDeleted: If existing broken-parcel / poison fixtures are removed, the card failed (P4 needs them).
falsifiers.randomHttpSample: If S6/S7 HTTP checks use Math.random or a shuffled sample, the card failed.

threeQuestionGate.fails: WALK_FAILED or test assertion on poison
threeQuestionGate.bypasses: a walk invocation that does not load the new rule ids (must be default-on)

threeQuestionGate.fails: poison fixture must FAIL the family; known-good must PASS
threeQuestionGate.bypasses: fixtures that the suite never loads
